parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: This is the cover of a trash can, made of durable plastic. It is a flat, hinged part that fits on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The cover prevents odors from escaping and keeps the trash concealed. It can be lifted or flipped open for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or lift open around a hinge or pivot point, depending on the design.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main container body of the trash can, made of plastic. It has a tapered shape for stability and easy waste removal.
parts.Functional_description: The container holds the trash and supports the cover. It is designed to contain waste securely and may hold a liner inside.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be lifted or carried when emptying or cleaning.
